claim: For arXiv id 1602.03837 (the first gravitational-wave detection) the tool routes to the arXiv branch and returns is_oa true, the arXiv PDF url, the DataCite DOI, and the linked journal DOI.

upstream_of_record.field: arXiv branch: kind/doi/is_oa/pdf_url (arXiv is unconditionally OA; cross-checked journal_doi via crossref)

notes: The OA fields were identical across two runs 40 minutes apart. Deliberately scoped to OA fields only: citation_count on this branch is NOT stable (null on run 1, 3793 on run 2), because that leg is Semantic Scholar and api.semanticscholar.org returns 429 to anonymous callers, which I reproduced directly. Old-style arXiv ids are out of scope: hep-th/9711200 and math/0211159 both return {"error":"not a DOI or arXiv id"}.
